description: Description The S-Curve Dashboard by Elwaha.net is a high-performance Power BI visual designed for project managers, planners, and analysts to monitor project health and progress. It provides a dual-axis interface to compare periodic values (bars) against cumulative performance (S-curve lines) in a single, intuitive view. Key Features: Automatic Cumulative Calculation: Provide periodic data and let the visual calculate the S-curve automatically, or provide your own cumulative fields. Value & Percentage Modes: Instantly toggle between absolute cost/value and percentage (%) completion modes. Smart Zoom & Pan: Deep-dive into specific project phases using mouse-wheel zoom and left-click drag to pan across your timeline. Built-in Range Slider: Filter your time window directly within the visual without needing external slicers. Integrated Data Table: A one-click toggle displays a detailed data grid below the chart for easy auditing and reporting. Advanced Typography: Full control over data label fonts, including family, size, bold/italic styles, and background opacity. Fully Interactive: Supports cross-filtering (inbound/outbound), tooltips, and a standard Power BI context menu.
